question: Does LICF provide unique protection for same-valid-presence-lease task continuity compared with a strong conventional nested fence?
proxy_notice: CURRENT_LEASE_ONLY models only the verified V15 presence surface, not every current/future Frank component. False allows attributed to it mean presence fencing alone cannot discriminate the case.
baselines: CURRENT_LEASE_ONLY: execution lease epoch plus proactive BUSY rule
TASK_EPOCH_SIMPLE: lease epoch + task id + task epoch + consent on switch
CONVENTIONAL_STRONG: TASK_EPOCH_SIMPLE + material revision + consent witness binding + idempotency nonce
LICF_001: CONVENTIONAL_STRONG semantics plus exact current fiber identity and successor-hash minting
metrics: mean and batch p50/p95/p99 local validation cost
promotion_gate: No promotion unless LICF beats CONVENTIONAL_STRONG on at least one material dimension without unacceptable regression elsewhere.
